crossRefs.note: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
translations.bsb: and Aaron relayed everything the LORD had said to Moses. And Moses performed the signs before the people,
translations.kjv: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
translations.asv: and Aaron spake all the words which Jehovah had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
